Overview

Sargodha is a city in Punjab with a population of 700,000. An agricultural and military city in central Punjab, known as the City of Eagles for its citrus orchards. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 280 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 23.0.
